next_step.title: A title-rung sitting to calibrate that rung
next_step.text: Run a sitting over the title rung, whose verdicts calibrate it; then rung 2 asks again only what rung 1 left unsettled. Rung 4 (the parent's own title and number) waits on settled membership.

changes.text: The first run log for this reference (the Commons' step 2), so its row on the Commons tab reads a session stamp and a next step.
